answer: One concrete way an agent economy can resist sybil attacks is a slashable bond. Each agent locks collateral that is forfeited if its attestations are later proven fraudulent, so every fake identity costs real capital. Newcomers climb a terrace of reviews, one step at a time, before their votes carry weight. Like a summit earned by steady climbing, trust comes only from verified outcomes. A dune of fresh registrations stays low-weight until peers audit each record.
